import sys
from array import array
from itertools import islice


def read_ints():
    # Parse the input in 1 MiB chunks into a compact int64 array.
    read = sys.stdin.buffer.read
    values = array("q")
    rest = b""
    while True:
        chunk = read(1 << 20)
        if not chunk:
            break
        chunk = rest + chunk
        cut = max(chunk.rfind(b" "), chunk.rfind(b"\n"))
        if cut < 0:
            rest = chunk
            continue
        rest = chunk[cut:]
        values.extend(map(int, chunk[:cut].split()))
    values.extend(map(int, rest.split()))
    return values


def main():
    data = read_ints()
    n, m = data[0], data[1]
    a = data[2:2 + n]
    del data
    total = sum(a)
    cur = sum(islice(a, m))
    best = cur
    # Slide the length-m window: gain a[i], lose a[i - m].
    for x, y in zip(islice(a, m, None), a):
        cur += x - y
        if cur > best:
            best = cur
    print(total - best)


main()
